units.source_text: 母亲说着，用掌心摸了摸女儿的额头。

en.t: As the mother spoke, she touched her daughter's forehead with her palm.

units.source_text: 非但没有发烧，反而是冰凉的。

en.t: Not only was there no fever; instead, it was ice-cold.

units.source_text: “大概是上北山杉村去，太累了吧。”

en.t: "She must be exhausted from going up to the Kitayama cedar village."
